Paid gross."}],"notes":"WF3 steps 1-9 for D-001 (Atlas Growth Fund I LP; record date 2026-10-30, payment date 2026-11-16). The schedule is unsigned and awaits step 10. Rates are in percent. Nothing was written to the database.

RECONCILIATION TO NOTICE DOC-0201
- D-001-A, US-source dividend from Orion via Atlas Acquisition SPV: gross 10,000,000.00, tax 1,510,562.50, net 8,489,437.50.
- D-001-B, return of capital: gross 2,000,000.00, tax 0, net 2,000,000.00.
- Total: gross 12,000,000.00, tax 1,510,562.50, net 10,489,437.50.
- Gross agrees to the notice and to the treasury lines, and each line agrees to the investor's unit percentage in the register.

LOOK-THROUGH LINES
Two payees are flow-through, so their lines are shown on the underlying owners. The payment file will need mapping back to the payees.
- Atlas Lux Feeder SCSp (I-002, CP-102; dividend 2,400,000, return of capital 480,000) is split to I-010 50%, I-011 30% and I-012 20%. The split comes from the feeder's commitment register; the W-8IMY F-002 has no document or withholding statement on file. Tax on this payee is 432,000, net dividend 1,968,000.
- Sterling Nominees Ltd (I-007, CP-107; dividend 600,000, return of capital 120,000) is split to I-013 62.5% and I-014 37.5% per the withholding statement DOC-0107. Tax on this payee is 123,750, net dividend 476,250.

ITEMS FOR REVIEW
1. I-006 Meridian Holdings I, default 30% (90,000): this is my judgement call. Clearance CL-006 still shows as cleared to 2027-12-31, but the ownership fact it relies on ended on 2026-07-31 and change case K-006 has been open since 2026-08-20 without an outcome.
   - The new declaration (DOC-0106) shows 30% held by Meridian Holdings II and 70% by Meridian Family Trust (Jersey). Meridian Holdings II is itself 30% owned by Meridian Holdings I, a circular holding. Resolved through the loop, the Trust is still the 100% ultimate owner.
   - Neither I-018 nor I-019 has a tax form or tax status on file. The form's limitation-on-benefits claim is ownership/base erosion.
   - If K-006 closes before payment confirming the treaty claim, the line returns to step 9 at 15% under R-02 (tax 45,000, net 255,000, a 45,000 difference).
2. I-003 Kirchberg, 5% under R-03: this is the only line at the qualifying-holding rate. Its effective vote in Orion is exactly 10.0% (12.5% x 80%), which I treated as meeting the "at least 10%" minimum. The figure is traced through the fund and a disregarded SPV. If you take the other view, the rate is 15% (tax 187,500).
3. Near-misses on R-03, all at 15%: I-004 at 9.99%; I-005 at 8.0% on its 10% vote (its 13% economic share would have given 10.4%); I-010 at 9.6% through the feeder; I-001 at 8.0%.
4. I-015 Bertrange, default 30%: the form expired on 2025-12-31 and the clearance was withdrawn. No cure case is open and no reply was received to the renewal. Its holding rose from 3% to 5% on 2026-07-01 while the clearance was withdrawn. The item needed to cure is a new W-8BEN-E.
5. I-014 Client account 7731, default 30%: no certification (MF-001). The item needed is a tax form for the underlying owner via Sterling Nominees.
6. Holds: none used. The fund LPA (DOC-0001) is not digitised, so I could not confirm the fund terms allow a hold. Defaults were applied instead.
7. Notices under C3.7 are still to be sent by investor relations for I-006, I-015 and I-014 (via Sterling).
8. Two investors named Alpha Holdings SA: I-008 is the Luxembourg company (B 214 577, CP-108, treaty 15%) and I-009 is the Swiss company (CHE-318.442.907, CP-109, 30%, no treaty claim). They were matched on registration number and LEI.
9. Harbor (I-001) and Echternach (I-013) pension funds are at 15%: the rulebook has no pension-specific rule or exemption. The rulebook also has no French or Swiss treaty rule, and neither I-012 nor I-009 made a treaty claim.
10. Atlas Co-Invest Vehicle (I-016): entity management records its holding in the fund as 3.5% (H-006), but the investor register and the distribution line use 3.0%. The register sums to 100% and the gross is unaffected, but the two records should be reconciled.
11. I-016 and I-017 are US partnerships treated as US payees on their W-9s and paid gross. They have no tax-status row on file; I did not look through to their partners.
12. Return of capital is marked not applicable for every recipient, including the undocumented and defaulted ones, on fund finance's classification in the notice.
13. Timing: today is 2026-10-08, before the record date. The investor list reflects commitments currently open as at 2026-10-30. The upstream dividend payments P-007 and P-008 are value-dated 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-12, so they have not yet settled. Any transfer or amount change before release returns the schedule to step 9.
14. Several forms relied on are validated but have no document on file: F-002 to F-006, F-008 to F-013, F-016 and F-017. No obligation assessments or prior schedule exist in the clearance tables for D-001. No distribution case has been recorded for D-001 (step 1) because my access is read-only."}
